name: io.github.jordanburke/microsoft-todo-mcp-server
description: Microsoft To Do via Graph — task lists, tasks, checklist items and reminders.

environmentVariables.name: MS_TODO_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Microsoft Graph access token. Set alongside MS_TODO_REFRESH_TOKEN to skip the token file; `mstodo-config` emits both.

environmentVariables.name: MS_TODO_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Microsoft Graph refresh token, used to renew the access token in place

environmentVariables.name: MSTODO_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the tokens.json written by `mstodo-setup` (default: tokens.json in the working directory)

environmentVariables.name: CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Azure AD application (client) ID — used by `mstodo-setup` to run the auth flow

environmentVariables.name: CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Azure AD client secret for the auth flow

environmentVariables.name: TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Azure AD tenant: 'organizations' (default), 'consumers', 'common', or a tenant GUID

environmentVariables.name: REDIRECT_URI
environmentVariables.description: OAuth redirect URI registered on the Azure AD app (default http://localhost:3000/callback)
